findings.title: [P1] Detach the message listener during unmount
findings.body: `mount` registers an anonymous listener — `socket.on("message", message => this.render(message))` — whose identity is never stored, and the new `unmount` body is just `this.socket = undefined`; the previous `this.socket?.off("message", this.onMessage)` teardown is deleted. After any `unmount`, the listener remains attached to the socket: incoming messages keep calling `render` on an unmounted view, every remount adds another live listener (duplicate renders), and the socket retains the `SocketView` via the closure for as long as the socket lives. This bites under completely normal mount/unmount cycles and no other code in the repository removes the listener. Restore the stored callback (e.g. `this.onMessage`) and call `socket.off("message", this.onMessage)` before clearing `this.socket`.
